newsitem.title: USA: Omnicare says to acquire research firm.
newsitem.headline: Omnicare says to acquire research firm.

text.p: Omnicare Inc said Wednesday it agreed to acquire Coromed Inc, a Troy, N.Y.-based contract drug research firm, for $40 million in Omnicare stock.
Expected to close in 90 days, the deal will be structured as a pooling of interests and is expected to be non-dilutive to Omnicare's 1997 earnings, Omnicare said in a statement.

Coromed, which had $8.7 million net revenues in the fiscal year ended in June, provides services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology and medical device firms and has special expertise in cardiovascular research and developments for HIV/AIDS and other infectious diseases, Omnicare said.

Omnicare provides pharmacy consulting services for nursing homes and other long-term care facilities. In the nine months ended Sept 30, it earned $0.48 a share ($0.44 diluted) on sales of $379.8 million.
Omnicare shares were off 1/2 to 28-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Coromex transaction is subject to Coromex shareholder approval and certain other conditions, Omnicare said.
